business_problem: Lojas Renner needed a better way to support retail AI agents for support automation, feedback analysis, and employee decision support because siloed data and fragmented systems made it difficult to scale AI initiatives that could improve support responsiveness and enterprise decision making.
solution_summary: Lojas Renner uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support retail AI agents for support automation, feedback analysis, and employee decision support. The implementation replaced a legacy state where siloed data and fragmented systems made it difficult to scale AI initiatives that could improve support responsiveness and enterprise decision making. Support calls and customer feedback move through production data pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. MLflow, Model Serving, and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver AI support agents and internal support answers.
business_outcome: Lojas Renner improved retail AI agents for support automation, feedback analysis, and employee decision support with measurable results including faster delivery from raw data to production decisions, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
architecture_clues: Centralized governance, lineage, and access controls are enforced through Unity Catalog.
Delta Lake provides the shared storage layer for curated lakehouse datasets.
Operational AI workflows are deployed directly beside governed data and analytics assets.
evidence_quotes: The challenge wasn’t just about responding to the requests,
Databricks unified everything, from governance and security to deployment. We built an end-to-end pipeline that just works. It was a game changer,
The automatic sync of changes to our AI Search ensures AI agents serve up-to-date and accurate responses, without any manual overhead,
Abstracting away infrastructure complexities allowed us to focus fully on delivering business impact,
